body_text: Independence grows through everyday moments: making choices, managing belongings, caring for the space and helping others.

items.title: Self-Help
items.text: Eating independently, washing hands and putting things away.

items.title: Caring for Our Space
items.text: Reaching materials on their own and returning them to their place.

items.title: Dining Hall Skills
items.text: Serving themselves, using cutlery, pouring water, waiting and practising table manners.

items.title: Feelings & Friendships
items.text: Connection first, correction later. Understanding emotions, expressing needs and solving small conflicts.
